actions.action: Bind approvals to exact paragraph revisions
actions.mechanism: Approval records identify both source and translation revisions; publication rejects mismatches rather than copying approval status forward.
actions.implementation: Store immutable revisions under stable paragraph IDs. Record language, reviewer, and both revision IDs on approval; validate against the release snapshot.
actions.check: Edit an approved source paragraph: publication must block it. An unchanged paragraph must retain eligibility. A concurrent edit must not bypass validation.
actions.risk: Translation edits must also invalidate the matching approval.

actions.action: Give each language a focused review queue
actions.mechanism: Compact review packets expose affected content without hiding the full source or restarting all six languages.
actions.implementation: Show changed paragraphs, prior approved text, source differences, current translation, and expandable context. Let the two reviewers claim items; require explicit reapproval.
actions.check: Test a move, unchanged paragraph, and substantive edit: label the move separately, omit unchanged work, and queue the edit in each language.
actions.risk: Difference highlighting guides attention; it cannot establish translation accuracy.

actions.action: Track context dependencies separately from paragraph text
actions.mechanism: Moves and related edits can invalidate meaning even when a paragraph’s own wording remains unchanged.
actions.implementation: Record dependencies for references, terminology, and context-sensitive neighbors. Queue dependent approvals for human reassessment; require a context check when paragraphs move.
actions.check: Move a paragraph containing “above”: require reassessment. Move a self-contained paragraph: permit its unchanged translation after context confirmation, without restarting the language.
actions.risk: Missing dependencies can conceal impacts; show surrounding text during reassessment.
